I couldn't run the formatter. The permission system blocked `npm run format` because it needs approval, and this session can't ask you for it, so no files were changed.

I checked what the formatter does first. `npm run format` runs `node scripts/lint.js --fix` on every `.js` file under `src/` and `tests/`. It replaces tabs with two spaces, strips trailing whitespace and makes each file end in exactly one newline. None of that changes behaviour. It doesn't touch `scripts/` or `package.json`.

To go ahead, either:
- run `npm run format` yourself and then `git status --short` to see which files changed, or
- allow `npm run format` (for example with `/permissions` or in `.claude/settings.json`) and ask me again. I'll run it and tell you which files changed.
